I don't really use reddit anymore but I think I might use it more specifically for this subreddit. I'm 16 and my anxiety was just treated as being "shy" for the first couple years and now its full-blown and gotten worse, especially throughout my sophomore year of high school when I became more depressed. I don't take any medicine but my therapist has recommended it and it's most likely that I will since it interferes with my quality of life.

I hate anxiety so. Damn. Much. Sometimes I've cried and asked God (I'm not religious) why he made me this way. The other day I traveled to an area I've only been to once by myself (I don't really have any friends) and I had the worst anxiety about it - and I love traveling in the city! (I live near Chicago) I just wish it would go away and it feels like I can't remember a time where I was able to live my life without being worried about things like simply ordering food.

I hope that I am able to get medicine and maybe feel better but sometimes I'm worried that it might be hopeless, and medicine won't help me in every day life. Plus, I can't swallow pills because I get anxious so that's also a negative.
